name: django-river-ml

vendor.company: Vanessa Sochat (vsoch / @vsoch), independent maintainer; active in the U.S. Research Software Engineering community (former Stanford Research Computing / LLNL)
vendor.scale: Small/niche. Single-maintainer research project, BSD-3 license. ~10 GitHub releases, latest v0.0.21 (2023-12-25). Self-described in repo header as 'under-development'. Low star count, no organizational backing. On PyPI as django-river-ml. Companion client: github.com/vsoch/riverapi (riverapi on PyPI).

ports: 6379/tcp (Redis, only if STORAGE_BACKEND='redis'; adjacent, not on the app port)

verification_primitive.probe: HTTP GET http://<host>:8000/api/ (or /<URL_PREFIX>/ if customized). Single unauthenticated GET, no body, no mutation.
verification_primitive.success_signal: HTTP 200 with JSON containing "name":"Django River ML Endpoint" and "id":"django_river_ml". Confirms a live django-river-ml instance with the always-unauth service-info view reachable. To confirm the data plane is open, GET /api/models/ returning 200 JSON list (not 401/403) proves DISABLE_AUTHENTICATION is in effect / the view is ungated.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: Read-only confirmation that an online-ML model server is exposed and unauthenticated, with model inventory and version metadata disclosed. The probe alters nothing.

endpoints.returns: ServiceInfo JSON, unauthenticated unconditionally (permission_classes=[], no is_authenticated call). Body: {"id":"django_river_ml","status":"running","name":"Django River ML Endpoint","description":"This service provides an api for models","documentationUrl":"https://vsoch.github.io/django-river-ml","storage":<backend>,"river_version":<ver>,"version":<pkg ver>}. Primary fingerprint.
JSON list of all registered model names. NOT in AUTHENTICATED_VIEWS, reachable even when auth enabled; trivially open when DISABLE_AUTHENTICATION=True (default).
JSON dict of model structure/params (model_to_dict). Gated only by AUTHENTICATED_VIEWS when auth on; open by default.

Raw dill-pickled River model object as application/octet-stream. NOT in AUTHENTICATED_VIEWS. Loading it with dill/pickle = arbitrary code execution on the consumer; also leaks the full model and learned parameters.
Server runs dill.loads(request.body) to register a model = untrusted pickle deserialization SERVER-SIDE. With default auth OFF this is an unauthenticated deserialization sink (potential host RCE).
201 with learn result; mutates the named model with attacker-supplied features/ground_truth (online model poisoning). In AUTHENTICATED_VIEWS but open by default.
200/201 with prediction + generated identifier; exercises the model. In AUTHENTICATED_VIEWS but open by default.
JSON per-model timing stats (learn_mean/predict_mean/EWM). NOT in AUTHENTICATED_VIEWS - open even when auth on.
JSON model metrics (model name in body required). In AUTHENTICATED_VIEWS.
SSE text/event-stream of live learn/predict events (can leak feature payloads in transit).
GetAuthToken; issues a JWT when valid credentials are presented (only meaningful when auth enabled).
